query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So Long, Stephen — But What a Ride!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just fix bugs — they *become* the bug whisperer. 🐛✨ And Stephen? He was basically a legend in debugging AND in dropping the perfect meme at the perfect moment. 😂

Whether it was a hilarious meme that somehow perfectly described our Monday morning stand-ups, or a genius solution that saved us all from a production nightmare — Stephen always delivered. 💪

As you close this chapter and open an exciting new one, remember: **the world is just one big codebase waiting for someone brilliant enough to refactor it** — and that someone is YOU. 🚀

We'll miss your wit, your wisdom, and yes… *especially* your memes. The Slack channel will never be the same. 😢

Go out there and **compile greatness**, Stephen. The best version of your story is still being written. 🌟

With all the love (and GIFs) in the world,
**Your [Company Name] Family** 💙

---

Feel free to customize the company name or add any personal inside jokes! 😊
